entry.title: Environmental crime: Who could go to prison for EUDR breaches?
entry.summary: The most serious breaches of the EUDR could result in prison time. For the majority of Member States, certain breaches fall under the Environmental Crime Directive, which legislates a maximum sentence of at least five years for some intentional EUDR breaches. Even Ireland, which does not come under the scope of the directive, may introduce prison sentences for breaches.
